title: Recalled historic high-water mark
description: One recalled, dry-season record of historic flood depth at a location. The plan's exact field set from assam-flood-implementation-plan.md PART 4 §2.5, plus schema_version (repo-wide rule), a cavities id (hwm_id) and submitted_at provenance pair so the recalled record's body can stay in the plan's exact shape. Never mixed with live crowd reports; seeds Phase 4.

submitted_at.description: When the recalled report was captured.

location.description: [longitude, latitude] rounded to the same three-decimal grid as crowd reports. Never finer than the 50 m policy floor.

reference_en.description: Plain-language reference such as 'up to the window sill'. Free text is scanned for inadvertently embedded phone numbers and email addresses at intake.
